concerns.text: T005a (Verify Full EBD Availability) is listed *before* T005b1/b2/b3 (Download/Verify Sample Data), but the description states it will fall back to sample data if full EBD isn't available. This creates a dependency violation – you can’t download the sample until you know the full dataset is unavailable, making T005a logically *after* the attempt to get the full dataset.

Tasks T005c1 (Download NOAA Data) and T005c2 (Verify NOAA Checksums) are missing from the task list, despite being explicitly required by FR-001 in spec.md and referenced in multiple other tasks. This is a critical omission.

T005b3 (Handle eBird Sample Fallback) depends on T005a, but the logic described in T005a *is* the fallback condition. This creates a circular dependency and suggests an incorrect ordering – the handling of the fallback should occur after the attempt to download full EBD is definitively failed.

T015b2 (Aggregate to Grid Cells) depends on T015b1 (Filter eBird Records), but the description doesn't explicitly state that filtering *must* complete before aggregation, creating ambiguity about task order.
T017b (Implement seasonal climate average calculation) has a dependency on T015b but the description doesn't clearly explain *how* it depends on that task, making the relationship unclear.

T043 (Calculate and Report All Success Criteria) lists dependencies on multiple Phase 2/3 tasks, but doesn't specify a clear order *within* those dependencies. For example, SC-001 depends on T011a, but the task description doesn’t indicate whether T011a must complete before other dependent tasks within T043.
